I saw that i was with a girl (asma) whom i had tried to marry as i loved her but it didnt happen due to various circumstances & i got married to another girl (arshiya), Asma is still unmarried. I saw that she was with me as my wife & with my current wife (arshiya) & my mom cooking rotis in the kitchen. I was asking her to go & sleep as she has to go to work the next day. there were other things as well which i dont remember properly such seeing her use a table spoon to hit my mom on her head jokingly & then my mom said that she already has a wound on her head. there were other things as well which i dont remember. request you to please provide me tabeer of this dream. Dua 1855 views Q. اگر کوئی شخص یا امام درگاہ جیسے اجمیر درگاہ ، نوگور درگاہ، حاجی علی درگاہ وغیرہ میں جاری سرگرمیوں میں حصہ لے یا ان کی رسومات کی حمایت کرے یا اس میں شامل ہو تو کیا وہ مشر ک ہوجائے گا؟ اور کیا ہمیں اس کو مشرک سمجھنا چاہئے؟ 1529 views Q. Asalamu 'alaikum, Firstly, jazak Allah for all of the questions you have answered for me. I want to remove the thought of this dream that I had a few weeks ago. At sunrise time, I went to sleep and I had this dream- before I went to sleep, I think I made du'a to Allah and said the shahadah before sleeping. I also think I had started writing a hamd (poem) and the night before I had finished, al hamdu lillah, a hamd on Asma ul husna. So I dreamt of 4 particular things. I don't know the order, but I remember seeing a lecturer talk about something to do with Islam, then all of the sudden I looked out of the window to see a beautiful scene of snow in my garden with the orangy-red night sky. Then I remember being on my prayer mat, facing the qiblah and making du'aa unto Allah. I remember supplicating Ya Mu'min (WAllahu 'alam) and I then saw a tree next to me (it was black and I think it had no leaves), it seemed like it was doing ruku' (WAllahu 'alam) and coming towards me, I kept on moving my head away and was still doing the du'aa. I woke up still mumbling the du'a. What could this mean? Jazak Allahu Khair for your continued patience. Ma' salam. 1857 views Q. Problems in My Marriage, Please advice 1975 views Q. خواب 911 views Q. Assalaam Ya Sheikh al Aziz, A couple of day before i had a dream before goin to sleep I was listening to Tariq jameel saab's bayan on the signs of the Qiyama, then while sleeping I had a dream In which I heard the Recitation of Sura qiyamah The verses are "fa ida Bariqal Basar wa Khasafal Qamar wa Jumi'a sshamsu wa al qamar....." and i saw there was a calamity i dont remember exactly what happend later, Could you please interpret this dream? jazakallahul Ahasanal Jaza fid Daarain 1466 views Q. میں پچھلے دو سال سے پی ایم ٹی (PMT)امتحان کے لیے کامیاب نہیں ہوپارہی تھی تو اس کے لیے میں نے ظہر کے بعد استخارہ کیااور سو گئی تو خواب آیا کہ ایک پلیٹ میں ایک طرف سرخ اور ایک طرف ہرے میٹھے چاول میرے لیے لائے ہیں تو میں نے سرخ چاول کھا لیا اور ایک بچہ بھی ڈبہ میں سرخ رنگ لیے ہوئے ہے ۔ اسی خواب میں دیکھا کہ بہت سارے ہرے درخت لگے ہیں ایک میں اولا لگا ہے لیکن چاہ کے بھی اسے چھو نہیں پارہی ہوں۔ کسی وجہ سے میں نے کچھ دن تک استخارہ نہیں کیا۔ کچھ دن بعد دوبارہ عشاء کے بعد استخارہ کیا تو خواب آیا کہ ایک پھل ہے جس کا چھلکا ہرا ہے اور اندر سے وہ سرخ ہے تو میں نے چمچ سے سرخ والا حصہ کھا لیا اور اس پھل کے بغل میں مینگو شیک بھی ہے۔ میں نے دونوں خواب میں سرخ چیز ہی کھائی ہے جب کہ وہاں ہری بھی تھی۔ آپ براہ کرم میری الجھن دور کردیجئے۔ 1520 views Q. Intercourse 2576 views Q. By the Mercy and Grace of Allah, i offer five times salat daily with jammat, i have a beared, wear topi, enjoin tableeghi jamaats and try to follow as much sunnahs as i can, but never have i ever been blessed with the sight of rasulallah in a dream. I sometimes hear about some people who have just started practicing the deen and that too for a few weeks or so and in couple of weeks he is blessed with such a blissful sight, and to me many years have passed and i havent had such a dream. I do not mean that its my right to see the prophit of Allah in my dream or that i deserve it, on the contrary i feel i am quite a sinful person, but i want to ask 1) is there something that i am missing in my ibadaats or ikhlaas? do i have to do dua or wazeefa for it? 2)Does seing the prophit in the dream means that a person will be righteous through out his life? because i have seen people who have had the privelege of a such dream but they now rarely offer salat. 3) is it so that every pious person sees the prophit peace be upon him in dream? Does every alim, mufti, sheikh sees him in his or her dream? 1470 views Q. I have seen in dream that i am reciting verse from surah nisa: wama kataluhu wama salabuhu..what is the taabir or my dream? 3108 views

Question: As salam alaikum brothers (1) Is my name MOHAMMED SABEEL ULLA is correct lots of people says that my name is wrong alhamdullilah i practice namaz 5 times a day (2) Is it ok to wear contact eye lences while performing whudhu .(3) Please clarify me about the difference between shirk and wasila i am confused about this things for years and yet i didnt get any useful opinion about this from anyone I have performed hajj in 2006 there in madina i met a scholar whao said wasila is also haram (4) and lastly for some many nights i am having dreams in which iam seeing 3-4 snakes 2 or 3 are nag snakes and one is a comman green snakes they appear after raining allover around house among those i kill one but i dont know about others usually i dont have these kind of bizzare dreams .I think my request will be fullfilled i will be thankfull for you brothers and allah for your kind services i am confident that you will be fully rewarded by allah for these kind deed "allah hafiz"as for my details i am an engineering graduate my birth day is 17th of zil hijjah 1403 hijrih i will be waiting for your reply Answer ID: 1982 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1304/1173=B) (1) The name is correct (2) What is contact eyelence? We could not understand it. Clarify what type of optic it is. (3) To regard an associate in Allah and His attributes i.e. believing in someone other than Allah as God, Nourisher, Giver of life and death etc is shirk (polytheism). While, supplicating Allah by the mediation of any virtuous act, any prophet, sahabi, the Throne of Allah, Key of His Treasures or His Eight Names (as mentioned in Hadith) is waseelah . Shirk and waseelah are far different from each other. Waseelah has been enjoined in the Quran as well: وابتغوا الیہ الوسیلۃ , it is surprising enough how you have been told that waseelah is haram whereas it has been mentioned in the ­duas of many sahih hadiths as well. (4) There are many enemies behind you. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
